title: 通义千问发布 Qwen3.8-Flash，多模态 MoE 模型，Qwen4 架构早期预览
content:
⚡️认识一下 Qwen3.8-Flash，一个多模态 MoE 模型，也是 Qwen4 架构的早期预览版，现已开放权重！
生产版本的 Qwen3.8-Flash 即将通过 QwenCloud API 提供，价格仅为每 100 万输入 token 0.16 美元，每 100 万输出 token 0.47 美元。
125B 参数 + 51B N-gram 嵌入，每个 token 仅激活 6B 参数。性价比无与伦比。
新特性：🥳 - 下一代架构：GDN + QSA 混合注意力、门控残差、N-gram 嵌入和 Muon 优化器，作为 Qwen4 所用架构的前身。 - 训练和推理成本大幅降低：训练成本仅为 Qwen3.7-Plus 的 1/9，同时在各方面表现均优于后者，在编程和办公任务上尤其突出。 - 性能强劲：在 DeepSWE 1.1 上得分 58.7，在 SWE-bench Pro 上得分 62.5，在 CoWorkBench 上得分 73.9，在 AndroidWorld 上得分 84.5，在 MathVision（带 CI）上得分 95.7。 - 原生 262K 上下文，可通过 YaRN 扩展至 1M。
我们还发布了 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的权重，让社区提前一睹我们为 Qwen4 探索的新架构。🚀
我们迫不及待想看看你用 Qwen3.8-Flash 构建出什么！👀👇 - 博客：https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.8-flash-next - 技术报告：https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next/blob/main/tech_report.pdf - Hugging Face：https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next?spm=a2ty_o06.30285417.0.0.1d73c921FsyOPe&file=Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - ModelScope：https://modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next?spm=a2ty_o06.30285417.0.0.1d73c921XAP2dV&file=Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

report.summary: Alibaba's Qwen releases Qwen3.8-Flash, a cost-efficient multimodal MoE model previewing Qwen4 architecture, with open weights and ultra-low API pricing.
report.background: Qwen3.8-Flash arrives amid intensifying competition in open-source large language models, where efficiency and cost are becoming as important as raw capability. Alibaba's Qwen team has been a leader in releasing openly licensed models, and this release continues that strategy while pushing architectural boundaries. The model uses a mixture-of-experts (MoE) design with 125B total parameters but activates only 6B per token, dramatically reducing inference cost. It introduces a hybrid attention mechanism (GDN + QSA), gated residual connections, N-gram embeddings, and the Muon optimizer—components that foreshadow the Qwen4 architecture. By training at roughly one-ninth the cost of Qwen3.7-Plus while outperforming it, Qwen3.8-Flash demonstrates that intelligent architecture design, not just scale, can drive progress. The release of both the Flash and Flash-Next weights signals confidence in this direction and invites community experimentation before Qwen4's full debut.
key_points: Qwen3.8-Flash is a multimodal MoE model with 125B total parameters, yet only 6B are activated per token. This sparse activation design keeps compute and memory usage low during inference, making it practical for a wide range of hardware setups.

It introduces several novel architectural components — GDN + QSA hybrid attention, gated residual connections, N-gram embeddings, and the Muon optimizer. These are described as a preview of Qwen4's underlying architecture, giving researchers an early look at Alibaba's future direction.

The model's training cost is just 1/9 that of Qwen3.7-Plus, while delivering better performance across the board. Coding and office-related tasks see particularly large improvements, showing that efficiency gains do not come at the expense of capability.

Benchmark results are strong: 58.7 on DeepSWE 1.1, 62.5 on SWE-bench Pro, 73.9 on CoWorkBench, 84.5 on AndroidWorld, and 95.7 on MathVision with CI. These numbers highlight its aptitude in software engineering, collaborative work, mobile agent control, and math reasoning.

The model natively supports a 262K-token context, expandable to 1M via YaRN. This makes it suitable for long-document analysis, codebase understanding, and complex multi-turn agent tasks. Both Qwen3.8-Flash and the experimental Flash-Next weights are freely available.

API pricing is set at $0.16 per million input tokens and $0.47 per million output tokens, making it one of the most cost-effective multimodal models available. This could significantly lower the barrier for startups and developers building AI-powered products.
report.impact: For the AI industry, Qwen3.8-Flash signals a shift toward efficiency-first model design, where sparse MoE architectures and novel optimizers can rival much larger dense models. Developers gain access to a powerful, open-weight model that runs with modest VRAM and can be deployed on-premises, while the API pricing undercuts many commercial alternatives. Regular users will eventually benefit from cheaper AI assistants and agents capable of coding, office automation, and mobile interaction. The architectural preview of Qwen4 also sets expectations for future open-source releases, potentially forcing competitors to adopt similar cost-saving techniques. Overall, this release democratizes high-performance multimodal reasoning and accelerates the trend of commoditizing top-tier AI infrastructure.
report.tools: To follow up, check the official Qwen blog and GitHub repository (QwenLM) for technical reports and updates. Try the open weights on Hugging Face (Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) or ModelScope. For deployment, explore vLLM or SGLang, which support efficient MoE inference. YaRN is key for extending context to 1M. Developers can also experiment with the Muon optimizer in their own training frameworks.
